answer: One concrete defense: make every new identity post a small bond that only unlocks after its first few graded answers pass review. Think of a knoll each newcomer must climb by the same path; a sybil farm pays for that climb a hundred times over. Pair it with a style check, where graders compare a fresh answer against earlier ones from linked accounts, so the same jade-green phrasing or one pearl of a metaphor recycled across names shows up as overlap.
